function.description:
Returns the total count of IP address subpools.

PRECEDENCE
Apply sections in order. Higher sections override lower sections when they conflict.

S0 Scope and hard boundaries
S0.1 Count-only tool for subpools.
S0.2 Do not use this tool as a detail/list source.
S0.3 If site is specified, count only subpools whose siteId exactly matches that site (no parent/child expansion unless explicitly requested).

S1 Invocation rules
S1.1 Pure count intent (for example, 'how many subpools'): call this tool directly.
S1.2 Filter/detail/list intent: use retrieval APIs instead of this count tool as the primary source.
S1.3 If user says 'pools' without specifying global vs subpool (or asks about both), call both api_countsGlobalIPAddressPools and api_countsIPAddressSubpools.

S2 Pairing rule with retrieval
S2.1 When rendering subpool lists from api_retrievesIPAddressSubpools, call this tool to provide total-result context.
S2.2 Use count-line formatting consistent with retrieval rules (for example, 'Showing 10 out of {total} results.' or offset form).

S3 Output format
S3.1 For count answers, return Markdown text.
S3.2 Never use build_key_value_set.
S3.3 Markdown-context requirement: never return widget-only output. If output includes KeyValueSet, response shape must include Markdown context as [Markdown intro, KeyValueSet, Markdown summary].

S4 Prohibitions
S4.1 Do not call retrieval APIs when user asks only for a simple total count.
S4.2 Do not present count output as subpool details.
function.name: api_countsIPAddressSubpools

siteId.description: The `id` of the site for which to retrieve IP address subpools. Only subpools whose `siteId` matches will be counted.
